candidate.name: Causal Provenance Differential (CPD)
candidate.mechanism: Propagate sparse GWT UseRef-tagged causal polynomial/differential terms through versioned deterministic InfluenceContracts; derive single-use lesion deltas and pair synergies algebraically; unsupported opaque/truncated boundaries become UNKNOWN_BLOCKED rather than fabricated exact credit.

live_refresh.owner_correction: GRT is the ATOMIC outer Thinkspace; GWT is one mechanism family inside it.
live_refresh.comparison: CCF measures state/order sensitivity and forms coordination cells; CPD measures causal-use contribution to verified outcomes/reward re-entry. Exact CCF receipts could become structural evidence for CPD InfluenceContracts, but this composition is untested.

proxy_measurement.interpretation: Exactness is expected by construction on the representable polynomial fixture; this is mechanism evidence only, not real-Frank causal validity.

resource_counterevidence.conclusion: Do not claim speed. Small cases are slower in the unoptimized Python proxy; larger sparse cases cross over. Native ClayCode/target-VPS evidence is mandatory.

prior_art.assessment: No component is new in isolation; only the scoped ClayCode/GWT use-tag + exactness-gated causal receipt composition is retained as a bounded combination candidate.

strongest_counterhypothesis: Bookkeeping/term growth and opaque boundaries erase practical benefit; conventional replay remains simpler and more robust.
next_falsifier: Implement CausalPolynomial/InfluenceContract as current ClayCode typed IR/runtime/library mechanism without grammar change if possible; compare against matched leave-one-out lesion replay on target-VPS/Harness episodes; measure opaque-boundary coverage, term growth, recovery/stale-epoch behavior and actual resources.
raw_rows_note: Full deterministic proxy sources, raw per-episode rows, double-fusion artifacts and controls are retained in the user-deliverable local packet; this shared feedback contains the measured summary and candidate source companion.
